messages.subject: Windows compiler flags
parts:
I've been sucked down the rabbit hole. Here's the
best reference I've found for built-in compiler
flags to signal which defective version of C++
a given Windows machine is using:

http://nadeausoftware.com/articles/2012/01/c_c_tip_how_use_compiler_predefined_macros_detect_operating_system

My current attempt at a fix doesn't use them, though.
I have my fingers crossed --- it's 10 minutes into
unit testing, which is the furthest I've gotten yet.

- Bob
